recognize_zh: 中央的嗜中性球核只分成兩個對稱的圓形葉片，中間以細窄的染色質橋相連，形似夾鼻眼鏡（pince-nez），染色質粗糙團塊狀，胞質有顆粒，這就是 Pelger-Huët 細胞。
features: Mature neutrophil with bilobed nucleus of two symmetric round lobes (pince-nez configuration)
Lobes connected by a thin chromatin bridge
Cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules and preserved granularity
Normal cell size; background red cells unremarkable
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at oil immersion shows a mature neutrophil with a bilobed nucleus composed of two symmetric round lobes joined by a thin chromatin bridge, in a pince-nez configuration. The chromatin is coarse and markedly clumped, and the cytoplasm contains fine neutrophilic granules. Findings are consistent with a Pelger-Huët cell; distinction between inherited Pelger-Huët anomaly and acquired pseudo-Pelger-Huët change requires assessment of the proportion of affected neutrophils, presence of hypogranulation or other dysplasia, and clinical history.

ddx.vs: Acquired change affects a variable subset of neutrophils and is often accompanied by hypogranulation and other dysplasia, whereas inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils with normal granules.
Band neutrophils have a curved, non-segmented nucleus of uniform width without a thin bridge between two round lobes.
Eosinophils are also bilobed but contain large orange-red refractile granules.
Metamyelocytes have a kidney-shaped nucleus with less condensed chromatin and no lobation.
